webster.text: Blamable; deserving censure; as the person who has done wrong, or the act, conduct or negligence of the person.

more.text: Guilty of; as culpable of a crime.

example.quote: It is far less probable, that culpable views of any kind should infect all the parts of the government at the same moment and in relation to the same object, than that they should by turns govern and mislead every one of them.
